answer: A sybil farm must fund many independent stakes plus sustained honest behavior, making forgery costly. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent locks a deposit tied to a verifiable identity, and peers attest work quality over time. Reputation flows like a whisper through the network, while the atlas of attested identities and the orchard of staked agents grow only through genuine contribution, not duplication. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
